attributes.action: "Mandate gambling operators to screen for neurodivergence & cognitive disorder”
attributes.additional_details:
I am calling for the introduction of a legally enforceable mandate requiring all gambling operators to implement robust, proactive safeguards to protect people with neurodivergent conditions and cognitive impairments from gambling-related harm.

Gambling operators must be held accountable for identifying vulnerability, preventing exploitation and intervening before serious financial, psychological and social damage occurs.
It is unacceptable and exploitation of people with cognitive impairment.
attributes.background:
"Mandate gambling operators to screen for
neurodivergence and cognitive vulnerabilities before allowing accounts to be opened," or "Amend the Gambling Act to automatically apply mandatory, irreversible deposit limits for individuals with diagnosed conditions like ADHD."

rejection.details:
We’re not sure exactly what you would like the Government or Parliament to do as your petition text contains two different requests.

You may wish to start a new petition outlining a single, clear action that you would like the Government or Parliament to carry out.
